'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Joseph Graham LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joseph Graham]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joseph Graham]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|Dantooine Base Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
